summary: Stay on your message: {campaign manager} hands you {incumbent}'s new mailer, which is about something other than {the problem} you run on.
realLife: In 2017 the former local reporter ran for the Virginia House on fixing a clogged commuter road, said her 25-year incumbent spent more time on bathroom policy, knocked thousands of doors and won.
